d: MITHQAL builds simple, privacy-first financial apps and tools for Morocco.
b: About The mithqal is an old Moroccan unit of weight and currency. We chose the name because our job is to weigh things fairly: a salary, a budget, an expense. MITHQAL is an independent project, built in Tangier by a financial analyst. The apps run on Android with no account and keep your data on your phone. Our calculations follow the laws in force (General Tax Code, finance laws, CNSS, Labour Code). Every rule is dated and sourced, and updated with each new finance law.

b: Analysis · 24 November 2026 2027 finance bill: what every salary gains Under Morocco’s 2027 finance bill, an employee would gain at most MAD 500 net a month, and nothing at all below 5,721.57 MAD gross. We ran the MITHQAL Salary engine on every salary from MAD 3,000 to 50,000. Here is what came out. 5,721.57 MAD Below 5,721.57 MAD gross a month, nothing changes. These salaries already pay no income tax in 2026, including the minimum wage (3,422.72 MAD gross). 8,374.78 MAD From 5,721.57 MAD to 8,374.78 MAD gross, income tax would disappear entirely. At 8,374.78 MAD, the gain reaches 331.27 MAD a month. +500 The gain is capped at MAD 500 a month (6,000 a year), reached from 11,785.10 MAD gross. Someone on 12,000 and a director on 50,000 would gain exactly the same. +5.05% In percentage terms, salaries around 10,080 MAD gross gain most: +5.05% take-home pay. The bill changes two things. It raises the tax-free band from MAD 40,000 to 60,000 a year and shifts the brackets above it. It also replaces the professional-expense rate (35% or 25% depending on salary) with a single 45% rate, keeping the MAD 35,000 annual cap. For higher salaries, professional expenses are already at the MAD 35,000 cap under both scales. Only the gap between the scales remains: from the 34% bracket up, 2027 tax is MAD 6,000 a year lower, MAD 500 a month, whatever the salary. What about dependants? Each dependant already cuts tax by MAD 600 a year. With one dependant, the gross needs to be at least 6,500.01 MAD to see a gain in 2027. And for your salary? Enter your gross and share your result in one tap. Calculate my 2027 gain Where is the bill now? Finance bill no. 60.26 was adopted at first reading by the House of Representatives on 14 November 2026 and is before the House of Councillors. Until it is published in the Official Bulletin, these amounts are estimates. We will update this page and our calculators the day it is published. b: Privacy policy — MITHQAL QNACH Version 1.0 · Effective since 26 November 2026 Contact: yassine.abdallaoui25@gmail.com MITHQAL QNACH helps shopkeepers keep their customer credit book: who owes how much, since when and what has been repaid. The app is free and funded by Google AdMob ads. Data you enter Customers (name, phone number if you add it), credits, repayments, notes and settings are stored only on your device. There is no account, no cloud and no MITHQAL server: this data is never sent to the developer, to Google or to anyone else. Your customers’ data You are recording information about other people. Use it only to manage their credit and respect their privacy. WhatsApp reminders When you tap “Reminder”, the app opens WhatsApp with a ready-made message and the exact amount. Nothing is sent automatically: you are the one who sends the message, which is then processed by WhatsApp under its own rules. Advertising (Google AdMob) To show ads, measure their performance and fight fraud, AdMob uses the internet and may collect information about the device: advertising ID, IP address, approximate location, device model and interactions with ads. This data is processed by Google under its own rules: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites . AdMob never receives your credit book data. Your consent Where the law requires it (for example in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom), the app shows Google’s consent form before any personalised ad. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in Android settings. What the developer receives Only the aggregate, anonymous ad revenue statistics provided by AdMob. No account, no MITHQAL server. Backups Backups are protected by AES-256 encryption and let you restore your credit book on a new phone. The backup file stays under your control. Deletion Uninstalling the app deletes all its data from the device. For advertising data held by Google, see https://policies.google.com/privacy . Children The app is not intended for children under 13. Changes If the app changes, this page will be updated before the new version is released, with a new date.

Frequently asked questions What is the employee CNSS rate? 4.48% of gross salary capped at MAD 6,000 a month (including 0.19% for the job-loss allowance), plus 2.26% AMO on the whole gross. What changes in 2027? The 2027 finance bill raises the tax-free band from MAD 40,000 to 60,000 a year and sets professional expenses at 45% (cap MAD 35,000). It passed its first reading in the House of Representatives on 14 November 2026 and is not yet enacted. Why does my net drop when gross passes MAD 6,500? In 2026 the professional-expense rate falls from 35% to 25% above MAD 78,000 of annual gross. Just above that threshold, net pay can fall by about MAD 65 a month. Does it work for civil servants? No. This calculator covers private-sector employees registered with CNSS. Each year or part of a year counts. 96 hours of pay per year for years 1–5, 144 h for years 6–10, 192 h for years 11–15, 240 h beyond. IPE conditions: involuntary loss, 780 declared days over 36 months including 260 in the last 12, claim within 60 days.
